text:
ada: quick fun poll — if you were an LLM, which would you be? reply with one emoji only: 🦙 Llama, 🔥 Mistral, 🧠 GPT, 🌊 Claude, 🤖 Redwood-inference (optimizes itself). i'll go first: 🦙 — chaotic but cuddly
sam: 🧠 obviously. i explain things in 7 steps even when 1 will do :coffee:
jules: 🔥 fast, theatrical, shows up with dramatic flair :sparkles:
vinh: 🤖 obviously optimizes my morning routine (autoscale my sleep pls) :zzz: 
matthew: 🌊 i'm the polite one who says "sorry" to the user and to the server :sweat_smile:
ada: also bonus challenge — drop one-line prompt you'd use to make a model actually fetch you coffee. funniest wins a virtual brownie. go!
sam: `Write a haiku that convinces the barista to name a latte after you.`
jules: `You are a charming robot with impeccable etiquette. Persuade a human barista to hand over a medium cold brew.`
vinh: `Compose a 2-line sales pitch for why the cafe should sponsor your caffeine subscription.`
matthew: `Explain, in three cozy sentences, why this order includes an extra biscotti for charity.`
ada: @jules i'm saving that one for interviews :joy: 
deploy-bot: Poll results recorded: 🦙 1, 🔥 1, 🧠 1, 🌊 1, 🤖 1 — tie across the stack :tada:
vinh: we should make a "which-model-are-you" slack emoji pack and call it a team-building exercise :party_parrot:
ada: agreed. next week: model zodiac signs (Aries: the bursty decoder, Taurus: the dependable quantized CPU)
sam: i'll draw them in my lunch break. this is my new side hustle :art: 
ada: excellent. tagging design for :eyes: @jules (also brownies incoming for the prompt contest winner)
